title: Clicking Due sorts in the page's usual order, and again in reverse
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop uses every standard term plus one day-of-the-following-month term of its own, and you sort the list by Due.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due on day 10 of the following month.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-08 Tenth.
  • Other terms of the shop (from other tests) may also be listed; the checks below are about the order of the named rows.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Name" column heading.
  2. Click the "Due" column heading.
  3. Click the "Due" column heading again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the rows are sorted by name A to Z.
  • Step 2: the rows return to the page's usual order: COD first, Due on Receipt second, the Net terms by number of days, then the day-of-the-following-month terms with {Term-A} among them, Credit Hold last.
  • Step 3: the order reverses: Credit Hold first, then the day-of-the-following-month terms (highest day first, {Term-A} among them), then the Net terms from the longest down to Net 7, then Due on Receipt, then COD last.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R6: “Clicking a column header sorts the table by that column, following the app-wide sorting rule: the first click sorts Name A to Z, Customers and Vendors lowest first, and Due in the S1-R5 order; each further click reverses the direction. The sort is not saved: leaving and returning to the page shows the S1-R5 order.”
  • S1-R5: “Rows are listed in this order on both tabs: COD; Due on Receipt; every Net term (standard and the shop's own) by number of days, lowest first; every "day of the following month" term by day, lowest first; any other term A to Z; Credit Hold last. Ties sort A to Z by name. The same order is used in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
